# appgatesdp_entitlements_optimization (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the object.

### Read-Only

- `action_usage` (String) Overall usage classification across all actions in this Entitlement.
- `actions` (Attributes List) List of optimization actions with suggested removals based on usage analysis. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `broad_rules` (String) Whether broad IP ranges were detected across actions in this Entitlement.
- `entitlement` (Attributes) Represents a Network Entitlement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlement))
- `policies_linked` (List of String) IDs of policies linked to this Entitlement.
- `recommended_days` (Number) Recommended number of days of usage data to consider for optimization.
- `remaining_days` (Number) Number of days remaining until the optimization recommendation expires.
- `suggested_operation` (String) Suggested optimization operation for the Entitlement.

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Applied action to the traffic.
- `hosts` (Attributes List) Hosts with their optimization analysis results. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions--hosts))
- `ports_or_types` (Attributes List) Ports or ICMP types with their optimization analysis results. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions--ports_or_types))
- `subtype` (String) Type of the IP Access action. Required unless the action is exclude.

<a id="nestedatt--actions--hosts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions.hosts`

Read-Only:

- `exempted` (Boolean) Whether this value is exempt from optimization analysis.
- `not_analyzed` (Boolean) Whether this value could not be analyzed (unsupported host, or a port in an action with an unsupported host).
- `range` (String) Optimization range classification for this value.
- `suggested_for_removal` (Boolean) Whether this value is suggested to be removed based on usage analysis.
- `value` (String) The host, port, or type value.


<a id="nestedatt--actions--ports_or_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions.ports_or_types`

Read-Only:

- `exempted` (Boolean) Whether this value is exempt from optimization analysis.
- `not_analyzed` (Boolean) Whether this value could not be analyzed (unsupported host, or a port in an action with an unsupported host).
- `range` (String) Optimization range classification for this value.
- `suggested_for_removal` (Boolean) Whether this value is suggested to be removed based on usage analysis.
- `value` (String) The host, port, or type value.



<a id="nestedatt--entitlement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entitlement`

Read-Only:

- `actions` (Attributes List) List of all IP Access actions in this Entitlement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlement--actions))
- `app_shortcut_scripts` (List of String) List of Entitlement Script IDs used for creating App Shortcuts dynamically.
- `app_shortcuts` (Attributes List) Array of App Shortcuts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlement--app_shortcuts))
- `condition_logic` (String) Whether all the Conditions must succeed to have access to this Entitlement or just one.
- `conditions` (List of String) List of Condition IDs applied to this Entitlement.
- `created` (String) Create date.
- `disabled` (Boolean) If true, the Entitlement will be disregarded during authorization.
- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `name` (String) Name of the object.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `optimization_score` (String) Indicates how optimized this Entitlement is based on usage data. Actions or hosts/ports/types/methods marked as optimizationExempt are excluded from this calculation. Licensed feature.
- `optimization_score_percentage` (Number) Numeric percentage score representing how optimized this Entitlement is based on usage data. Licensed feature.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes.
- `site` (String) ID of the Site for this Entitlement.
- `site_name` (String) Name of the Site for this Entitlement. For convenience only.
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.
- `type` (String) The type of the Entitlement.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.

<a id="nestedatt--entitlement--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entitlement.actions`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Applied action to the traffic.
- `hosts` (List of String) Hosts to apply the action to. See admin manual for possible values.
- `methods` (List of String) HTTP method. Only valid for http subtypes. Leave it empty to allow all types.
- `monitor` (Attributes) Only available for tcp_up and http_up subtypes. If enabled, Gateways will monitor this action for responsiveness and act accordingly. See admin manual for more details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlement--actions--monitor))
- `optimization_exempt_hosts` (List of String) Hosts exempt from Entitlement Optimization analysis. Traffic to these hosts will not be considered when calculating the optimization score for this action. Uses the same format as hosts.
- `optimization_exempt_methods` (List of String) HTTP methods exempt from Entitlement Optimization analysis. Traffic using these methods will not be considered when calculating the optimization score for this action. Only valid for http subtypes.
- `optimization_exempt_ports` (List of String) Destination ports exempt from Entitlement Optimization analysis. Traffic on these ports will not be considered when calculating the optimization score for this action. Only valid for tcp, udp, ssh, and rdp subtypes. Uses the same format as ports.
- `optimization_exempt_types` (List of String) ICMP types exempt from Entitlement Optimization analysis. Traffic of these types will not be considered when calculating the optimization score for this action. Only valid for icmp subtypes. Uses the same format as types.
- `ports` (List of String) Destination port. Multiple ports can be entered comma separated. Port ranges can be entered dash separated. Only valid for tcp, udp, ssh, and rdp subtypes
- `subtype` (String) Type of the IP Access action. Required unless the action is exclude.
- `types` (List of String) ICMP type. Only valid for icmp subtypes.

<a id="nestedatt--entitlement--actions--monitor"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entitlement.actions.monitor`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `timeout` (Number) Number of seconds the action needs to be unresponsive to mark the action unhealthy.



<a id="nestedatt--entitlement--app_shortcuts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entitlement.app_shortcuts`

Read-Only:

- `color_code` (Number) The color code of the shortcut on the client.
- 1: Light Green
- 2: Green
- 3: Indigo
- 4: Deep Purple
- 5: Yellow
- 6: Lime
- 7: Light Blue
- 8: Blue
- 9: Amber
- 10: Orange
- 11: Cyan
- 12: Teal
- 13: Deep Orange
- 14: Red
- 15: Gray
- 16: Brown
- 17: Pink
- 18: Purple
- 19: Blue Gray
- 20: Near Black
- `description` (String) Description for the App Shortcut which will be visible on the Client UI.
- `group_name` (String) The group name this shortcut is to be grouped by
- `name` (String) Name for the App Shortcut which will be visible on the Client UI.
- `url` (String) The URL that will be triggered on the OS to be handled. For example, an HTTPS URL will start the browser for the given URL.
